product_one_liner.value: Advocate standardizes commercial insurance policies and benchmarks pricing and coverage to help brokers, loan servicers, carriers, and property owners identify coverage gaps and make placement and renewal decisions.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page exists; enterprise pricing is custom.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in the homepage logo wall.

employee_band.notes: Based on a LinkedIn employee count of 74.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows one company launch and funding announcement, not an engineering blog with at least two qualifying posts.

public_docs.notes: Public API documentation covers authentication, query parameters, responses, errors, rate limiting, and workflow guides; the help center also contains multiple article collections.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The five listed openings are Platform Engineer, two Product Engineer positions, Client Solutions Manager, InsurTech, and Insurance Consultant; none has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The security page names both as inference providers under enterprise agreements configured for zero data retention.

compliance_certs.notes: Specifically SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001:2022.

last_funding.notes: The latest identified round was announced on August 4, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The $18 million seed round announced in August 2026 falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: None of the five listed openings is an SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Advocate publicly launched on August 4, 2026, introducing standardized commercial-insurance pricing and coverage benchmarks.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying C-level or VP-level company join or departure could be verified for the requested window, and the about page does not provide a complete named leadership roster.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The reviewed job postings and documentation name no CRM or sales/marketing system. The Client Solutions Manager posting mentions CRM platforms generically without naming a vendor.
